summary: Review B, documents/server/database/security/Send checklist, and owner decisions OD12-OD14 in full. The documents were made safe before the gate went: defaults 'Koala Insulation', terms naming no town, 'Limited lifetime warranty'; any stored /placeholder/i text counts as unset; the consent sentence never throws (property state, else shop state, else the acts by name); a bad prefix falls back to KN. Then the business-profile gate is gone everywhere (route 409, checklist item, bundle gaps, SendStep branch and links, Pricing nags); /admin/business is an optional owner page. An additive conditional migration section replaces the seeded company, terms and warranty only where they are still exactly the seed (production's are). A test builds the quote, the real PDF, the emails and the page from the exact migration-seeded rows and from production's rows as they are today. Security: next= open redirect closed (and the repeated next= 500), price approvals bound to the loaded cost and written by the server only, the owner's queue drops stale requests and PATCH answers 409 for a signed estimate. Test databases now get production's grants. Hard rule 1: 2,926 stored-quote renders, 0 differences against the before code rendered the same day; against the quotes stage's stored before set only 4 clock-dependent files differ (two quotes expired between the renders; each equals its expired page). Hard rule 3: a parser-based scan finds no franchise text in app/, lib/, components/ beyond two documented exceptions.
